# SI043 — payable-method-present

v1 has no payable methods.

## Why

Money turns policy findings into a financial mechanism with legal and economic design risk.

## Bad

```python
@gl.public.write.payable
def fund(self) -> None: ...
```

## Good

```python
@gl.public.write
def file_incident(self, ...) -> str: ...
```

## Suppression
